summary: Sprint 2.5 — Property persistence end-to-end (Frontend → FastAPI → Supabase PostgREST + Storage) FULLY VERIFIED. All 11 acceptance assertions PASS with zero console errors and zero page errors. Property created via Workspace persists in Supabase, card cover image loads from a real Supabase signed URL over https, search filters correctly, and data survives a full page reload (real DB persistence, not in-memory).
critical_code_review_comments: WorkspaceService.save (workspace-service.ts L31-49): clean orchestration — create property → upload photos in order → set cover only if user picked a non-first photo → upload documents. Cover is set explicitly only when coverIndex > 0 which relies on backend auto-covering the first uploaded photo; consistent with observed behavior (2nd photo cover click resulted in cover on 2nd photo after save).

ApiPropertyRepository/ApiPropertyFilesGateway: correctly use env.backendUrl + /api prefix (Kubernetes ingress requirement). Multipart uploads use FormData without setting Content-Type header (browser sets boundary automatically) — correct.

PropertiesScreen L37: img `src={property.coverImage}` renders the signed URL directly. Signed URL confirmed live: https://tlptpyhtddwaiwzmzgcg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/sign/property-images/... Consider adding `onError` fallback to noimage state in case signed URL expires while user is on the page (minor UX suggestion, not blocking).

PropertyWorkspace handleSave: swallows the error message in the catch block (shows generic toast). For production diagnostics, consider logging the underlying error via console.error to aid future debugging — not blocking for MVP.
PropertiesScreen 0 m² / empty neighborhood: card gracefully renders when optional fields are empty. Good defensive rendering.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/vera_test_imgs/photo1.png, photo2.png (1x1 PNGs) and plano.pdf (minimal valid PDF). Test property title 'TEST Depto Palermo 1784158115' persisted to Supabase; NOT cleaned up (no delete UI). Backend may accumulate TEST_ rows over iterations — main agent may want to periodically prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full end-to-end flow verified against REAL Supabase persistence (not mock). Key testids used: new-property-button, input-title, input-price, operation-venta, photo-file-input (hidden, use set_input_files), doc-input-plano (hidden, use set_input_files), photos-grid child divs data-testid='photo-', cover- badge, workspace-save. Photo processing spinner (~4-6s simulated) does NOT block save — waited 6.5s in test to be safe. Redirect to /propiedades happens ~800ms after success toast. Signed URLs are Supabase storage sign endpoints with an expiring token query param; card renders them directly. After reload, the same property is fetched from backend GET /api/properties and cover_image is a freshly-generated signed URL — persistence confirmed.
